Remark
[One- and two-form components of the Hodge-de Rham Laplacian] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0297, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0298 1. Section A.4\group second-order-differential-operators

For a $1$-form $\theta $, \[ \Delta _d\theta =(\Delta \theta _i-R_i^{\ j}\theta _j)\, dx^i. \] For a $2$-form $\alpha $, \[ \Delta _d\alpha = \bigl(\Delta \alpha _{ij} + g^{kp}g^{\ell q}R_{ijk\ell }\alpha _{qp} - g^{k\ell }R_{ik}\alpha _{\ell j} - g^{k\ell }R_{jk}\alpha _{i\ell }\bigr)\, dx^i\wedge dx^j. \]
